body:
### Summary

`uv pip install` aborts with SIGABRT inside the 32-bit `quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_28_i686` container (started by cibuildwheel, which runs
`python -m build --installer=uv`) when the host is a GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-26.04` runner. The same job with the same container image digest passed
on `ubuntu-24.04` (last green run 2026-10-29). The x86_64 container on the same ubuntu-26.04 runner works.

Full output of uv:

```
+ python -m build /project --wheel --outdir=/tmp/cibuildwheel/built_wheel --installer=uv
* Creating isolated environment: venv+uv...
  Using external uv from /usr/local/bin/uv
* Installing packages in isolated environment:
  - cython>=3.2.9
  - setuptools-scm>=8
  - setuptools>=84
  - wheel
  - ziglang>=0.17.1
< failed to create UnixStream: Os { code: 38, kind: Unsupported, message: "Function not implemented" }
ERROR Command '['/usr/local/bin/uv', 'pip', 'install', 'ziglang>=0.17.1', 'setuptools-scm>=8', 'cython>=3.2.9', 'setuptools>=84', 'wheel',
'--python', '/tmp/build-env-gyaxuj3k/bin/python']' died with <Signals.SIGABRT: 6>.
```

Errno 38 is ENOSYS: a syscall the 32-bit process makes is not implemented/allowed. On i386 sockets go through `socketcall` or separate
`socket`/`socketpair` syscalls, so my guess is a seccomp-profile or kernel-config difference on the new runner image / Docker version (the
`UnixStream` creation looks like a socketpair, e.g. a signal/wakeup pipe in the async runtime). I have not confirmed this, and I cannot rule out
that uv itself changed between the two runs: the uv inside the container is the one cibuildwheel installs, and I did not capture its version.

What changed between the last green and the first red run:

|  | green (2026-10-29) | red (2026-11-07) |
|---|---|---|
| Runner image | ubuntu-24.04 20261025.353.1 | ubuntu-26.04 20261101.186.1 |
| Docker server | 28.0.4 | 29.4.2 |
| Kernel | 7.0.0-1017-azure | 7.0.0-1019-azure |
| uv on the host (setup-uv) | 0.13.6 | 0.13.7 |
| Container | manylinux_2_28_i686@sha256:541324ddb178a1611c25485a8fcce73c227131f273a510006b9fb0bfa0672d27 | same digest |

Reproducing: a GitHub Actions job on `ubuntu-latest` (now 26.04) running cibuildwheel with `build-frontend = "build[uv]"` and `--archs i686`.
Minimal repro outside CI, not yet tried: `docker run --rm quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_28_i686 sh -c 'pip install uv && uv pip install --python /opt/python/cp310-cp310/bin/python wheel'` on an ubuntu-26.04 host.

Not done yet, and would tell whether this is a uv bug at all: rerun on `ubuntu-24.04`; run the container with `--security-opt seccomp=unconfined`.

Logs: failing job https://github.com/o-murphy/rp2040py/actions/runs/42415595170/job/128532856289, last green run https://github.com/o-murphy/rp2040py/actions/runs/40858286448.
I searched this tracker for `UnixStream`, `i686`, `ENOSYS`, `SIGABRT`, `socketpair` and found no matching issue.

### Platform

Ubuntu 26.04 x86_64 host (GitHub-hosted runner, kernel 7.0.0-1019-azure), running an i686 manylinux_2_28 container under Docker 29.4.2

### Version

Not captured for the uv inside the container (installed by cibuildwheel). Host uv from setup-uv: 0.13.7 (0.13.6 on the last green run).

### Python version

Python 3.10.22 (cp310-manylinux_i686)
title: uv aborts (SIGABRT, "failed to create UnixStream: Function not implemented") in the i686 manylinux container on GitHub's ubuntu-26.04 runner
